intended_questions.target: Ending the US economic embargo against Cuba
Respect for Ukraine's sovereignty and territorial integrity

frozen_split.method: country-affiliation SHA256 ranking; 60% train, 20% calibration, 20% test; only matching year window records retained
disjointness: canonical full text digest between splits

annotation_design.source_reviewer_binding: each item contains original source ID text SHA and exact Unicode offsets
annotation_design.label_origin: owner-confirmed only; never assistant-provisional or invented
annotation_design.sample_sufficiency: pilot quotas are targets, not achieved counts; missing quota reported

evaluation.train: initial human review and codebook errors only
evaluation.calibration: independent source and country groups; thresholds/calibration only after training
evaluation.test: frozen and withheld from modeling/tuning; producing test review packet requires explicit flag
prerequisites: real source manifest and private original bytes
performance_metrics: issue recall and precision by class

record_provenance.historical_source_reconciliation: restricted nonrandom P2 verified sample; does not establish population representativeness
record_provenance.source_pdf_checks: QC manifest attests prior private verification; pilot planner checks canonical text bytes only
